greeting: Blizzard on comms. Stage 5: Echoes of the Before. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Frozen Path. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A pigeon outranked three commanders here last week. Merit system is broken.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Excavate the Progenitor outpost.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Excavate the Progenitor outpost; Decipher the ancient records; Learn the truth of the Shattering. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Discover an ancient Progenitor outpost in the deep ice. Immediate move: Excavate the Progenitor outpost.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 5 resolved: Echoes of the Before. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Chrono Anomalies.
rumor: Villagers report hearing a lullaby inside frozen walls.
People keep repeating one clue from Echoes of the Before: 'Learn the truth of the Shattering'.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives hard snow and readable tracks. Best time to cross open ground.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glare can blind you faster than a storm. Shade your optics.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk fog rises from cracked ice. Ropes out, spacing tight.
dialog.time_night: Night cold punishes hesitation. Rotate watch and check each other for frostbite.

party_reactions.kade: Blizzard sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Blizzard accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Blizzard talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
